# Vendor Profile — ADP Payroll Services

**Vendor Profile: ADP Payroll Services**  

---

## Overview  
ADP Payroll Services is a leading provider of payroll processing and workforce management solutions. Crestwood Capital Group partners with ADP to ensure accurate and compliant payroll services across global operations. ADP has been a trusted vendor since 2012, supporting Crestwood’s growth and evolving workforce needs.  

---

## Services Provided  
ADP delivers end-to-end payroll processing, tax compliance, benefits integration, and employee self-service tools. Their solutions are tailored to Crestwood’s global footprint, ensuring compliance with local regulations in the Americas and APAC regions. ADP also provides advanced reporting and analytics to support workforce planning.  

---

---

## Contract & Relationship Notes  
Crestwood’s current contract with ADP runs through June 2027, with a three-year renewal option. The agreement includes a 99.5% payroll accuracy SLA and a 48-hour resolution window for critical issues. ADP provides quarterly performance reviews and a dedicated account manager. While overall satisfaction is high, Crestwood has flagged occasional delays in APAC tax filings, which are being addressed through enhanced escalation protocols. ADP remains a strategic partner, critical to supporting Crestwood’s global workforce operations.
